premise: I drained my $96,000 nursing pension to rescue a vintage 1950s diner car and launch a retro milkshake bar with my stepdaughter, who signed a 50/50 partnership and promised free milkshakes for my grandkids every Friday, but after a restaurant group offered $650,000 for the diner car and recipes she forged a title transfer, sold the business, and mailed me a $3,500 “tip” check; I found the original agreement stuffed inside the jukebox, proved the forgery, and now run ‘Shake of Betrayal Diner,’ where she scrubs the chrome grill in a shirt that says ‘Grilled My Trust’ and every receipt prints the perjury case number.
